title: Tyson Peek-a-Boo, at Home
sub: Monday to Friday. Inspired by the peek-a-boo style, not Tyson's exact program.
note: Tyson's coach Cus D'Amato built the peek-a-boo style: high guard, constant head movement, punches from angles.

items: Tie a string between 2 chairs at chin height, slip left and right along it.
Bob and weave under the line
Gentle pressure with your hand, hold still.
Gloves on your cheeks, move your head before every punch.
